name: Globe
description: Shows the artwork of your libraries on globes you can turn and zoom; a double-click opens the title.
overview: Builds globes from your libraries in the admin page: posters, backdrops, thumbs, logos, clearart, banners, discs, home videos and photos, each in its own shape, sorted or random, with a highest rating per globe. A header button opens the globe over Jellyfin Web, turned and zoomed like a map; a double-click opens, plays or shows the title. Games from Playnite Bridge too. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
